Plan your day in five minutes. Actually finish it.

Stillday puts your tasks, calendar and notes in one calm place. Every morning it suggests a realistic plan for the day, so you stop carrying a to-do list you'll never finish.

A simple habit that changes your week.

Most to-do apps help you collect tasks. Stillday helps you choose the right ones.

1

Collect everything

Add tasks from email, Slack or your phone in seconds. Nothing falls through the cracks.

2

Plan the day

Each morning, Stillday suggests what fits around your meetings. Drag to adjust, then start.

3

Close the day

A two-minute review moves unfinished work to a sensible time, so tomorrow starts clean.

Your calendar and tasks, finally together.

Connect Google Calendar or Outlook and see your tasks next to your meetings. Stillday blocks time for important work before the week fills up.

  • Two-way sync with Google and Outlook calendars
  • Time blocking with one drag
  • Focus mode that silences notifications

Notes that link to the work.

Meeting notes, ideas and checklists live next to the tasks they belong to. Search finds anything in under a second.

  • Notes attached to tasks and meetings
  • Templates for one-to-ones, projects and weekly reviews
  • Works offline, syncs when you're back
6.5 hrssaved each week, on average

Questions

What is the best way to plan your day?

Pick your three most important tasks, block time for them around your meetings and leave some free time for surprises. Stillday does this for you each morning based on your calendar and deadlines.

Does Stillday work with Google Calendar and Outlook?

Yes. It syncs both ways with Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar, so changes show up everywhere.

Is my data private?

Your tasks and notes are encrypted and never sold or shared. You can export or delete everything at any time.

Can I import from another to-do app?

Yes. Import from Todoist, Things, Microsoft To Do or a CSV file in a couple of clicks.

Tomorrow can be a calmer day.

Free for personal use. Set up in two minutes.

# Productivity App

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/saas-landing/productivity-app/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
